title: Locker
description: A permission-controlled container grouping credentials for bot access. Lockers define which roles (consumer roles) can access the contained credentials during automation execution.

description.description: Optional description of the locker's purpose

ownerId.description: User ID of the locker owner

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created this locker

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the locker was created

updatedBy.description: ID of the user who last modified this locker

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification
